source: Compiled 2026-10-13. (1) physgun.com Valheim item database, https://physgun.com/tools/valheim/items/ and per-item pages (recipes, stations, prefab IDs; 'read from Valheim 1.0.15 game files'). (2) physgun.com Build Calculator catalog, https://physgun.com/tools/valheim-build-calculator/ (414 piece rows with prefab IDs, game files 1.0.15). (3) Valheim Wiki (weirdgloop) https://valheim.weirdgloop.org/ : Module:Recipe/Data.json (427 recipes, cross-check, 9 Feast recipes), Module:ID/Data.json, pages Fermenter / Cooking Station / Stone Oven / seasonal pieces. (4) https://www.gameserverkings.com/knowledge-base/valheim/valheim-item-ids/ (1.0.7 prefab IDs of new items, cross-check). Achievements: 'The Artisan' = AllItemCraft (Craft every kind of item), 'The Carpenter' = AllBuildPieces (Build everything), per wiki Module:Achievement/Data.json.
notes: CRAFTABLES: kind=recipe (428) = real recipes selectable at a station (Workbench, Forge, Black Forge, Galdr Table, Cauldron, Food Preparation Table, Mead Ketill, Artisan Table, Stonecutter, player crafting menu), 1.0.15 game data; cross-checked with the wiki recipe module (427 recipes): names and stations agree; physgun adds Raw Fish, the wiki adds the 9 Feast dishes and Mead Horn of Oden (all merged). 'lvl' = minimum station level. kind=conversion (49) = items made by processing stations (Cooking station, Iron cooking station, Stone oven, Fermenter), NOT recipes; whether they count for The Artisan is NOT verified, filter by 'kind' if not wanted. Not included: outputs of smelter/kiln/blast furnace/windmill/spinning wheel/Eitr refinery (bars, charcoal, flour, thread), Forge of Potential upgrades, quality upgrades. Moulds ('Mould: ...') are loot, not craftable. Fermenter has 20 outputs; MeadTrollPheromones exists as a prefab but is not a fermenter product (omitted). Cooked Seal Blubber under Stone oven follows the wiki oven list. Cooked Egg is a Cauldron recipe (listed as recipe). Uncertain: 'Early Axes' (AxeEarly) is a Workbench recipe in the game data, taken as is. Names come from physgun (game localization) and may differ in capitalisation from the wiki. PIECES: 387 hammer pieces from the physgun catalog (414 rows) after removing 22 Cultivator plantings (sapling_*, *_Sapling, VineAsh_sapling, VineGreen_sapling) and 5 Hoe entries (raise_v2, paved_road_v2, Placeable_Stone, placeable_bigrock_01, placeable_bigrock_02; wiki version history confirms 'Hoe: 2 placeable boulders', the other three are assumed Hoe). 'req' = station that must be nearby to place the piece. Plus 9 SEASONAL pieces (flag=seasonal-uncertain) taken from the wiki: only buildable in event windows and absent from the physgun catalog; unclear whether The Carpenter requires them, filter on 'flag' if unwanted. Other uncertain: Eternal Pyre is piece_EternalPyre in the catalog (wiki lists id piece_FaderEmbers); obsidian_pile is on the wiki but not in the 1.0.15 hammer catalog (omitted); Trailership is console-only (omitted); Ancient Metal Stack is removed. Hammer tab per piece is not included. Battle/Protection Idols are loot items, not pieces. Not accessible: valheim.fandom.com, valheim.wiki.gg, valheim.tools (HTTP 402/403); game8 and gamecore not needed. Everything is a third-party reading of game files 1.0.15 (the live patch may be newer) - verify in game if exactness matters.
